author: nickyeow

english.text: He does not smoke.

jyutping: keoi5 m4 sik6 jin1。
text: 佢唔食煙。

author: nickyeow

english.text: With all his efforts, he failed the test.

jyutping: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 ji5 ging1 bok3 saai3 meng6 wan1 syu1，daan6 hai6 caak1 jim6 dou1 hai6 fei4 zo2 lou2。
text: 雖然佢已經搏晒命溫書，但係測驗都係肥咗佬。

author: nickyeow

english.text: When are you going to stop laughing like an idiot?

jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 m4 hou2 seng4 go3 so4 zai2 gam2 hai2 dou6 siu3 aa3？
text: 你可唔可以唔好成個傻仔噉喺度笑呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: You will soon get to like him.

jyutping: nei5 hou3 faai3 zau6 wui5 hoi1 ci2 zung1 ji3 keoi5 gaa3 laa3。
text: 你好快就會開始鍾意佢㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How long is this pencil?

jyutping: ne1 zi1 jyun4 bat1 jau5 gei2 coeng4 aa3？
text: 呢支鉛筆有幾長呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Telephone booths are as scarce as hen's teeth around here.

jyutping: ni1 dou6 fu6 gan6 di1 din6 waa2 ting4 siu2 dou3 aa3 maa1 dou1 m4 jing6 dak1。
text: 呢度附近啲電話亭少到阿媽都唔認得。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Let me take you home.

jyutping: ngo5 sung3 nei5 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1。
text: 我送你返屋企啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I left something in the room.

jyutping: ngo5 lau6 dai1 zo2 di1 je5 hai2 gaan1 fong4 dou6。
text: 我漏低咗啲嘢喺間房度。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If he had been a little more careful, the accident would have been avoided.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 zoi3 siu2 sam1 di1，zau6 m4 wui5 ceot1 si6 laa1。
text: 如果佢再小心啲，就唔會出事啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I met her by chance on the train the day before yesterday.

jyutping: ngo5 cin4 jat6 hai2 fo2 ce1 dou6 zong6 dou3 keoi5。
text: 我前日喺火車度撞到佢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please shut the door behind you.

jyutping: m4 goi1 nei5 saan1 zo2 nei5 hau6 min6 go2 dou6 mun4 keoi5 aa1。
text: 唔該你閂咗你後面嗰道門佢吖。

author: tigro1973

english.text: The magazine Look is no longer being published.

jyutping: Look m4 zoi3 ceot1 laa3。
text: Look唔再出嘞。

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom didn't want to interrupt Mary while she was studying.

jyutping: aa3 Tom m4 soeng2 hai2 Mary duk6 syu1 go2 zan6 daa2 gaau2 keoi5。
text: 阿Tom唔想喺Mary讀書嗰陣打攪佢。

author: fercheung

english.text: I fell asleep while listening to the radio.

jyutping: teng1 teng1 haa5 sau1 jam1 gei1，ngo5 fan3 zoek6 zo2。
text: 聽聽吓收音機，我瞓著咗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm not sure of it either.

jyutping: ngo5 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 hang2 ding6。
text: 我都唔係好肯定。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Release him!

jyutping: fong3 zo2 keoi5！
text: 放咗佢！

author: nickyeow

english.text: The last day to apply is the day after tomorrow.

jyutping: hau6 jat6 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 jat6 bou3 meng2。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You don't have to answer today.

jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam1 jat6 fuk1 ngo5。
text: 你唔使今日覆我。

author: nickyeow

english.text: According to the paper, it will snow tomorrow.

jyutping: bou3 zi2 waa6 ting1 jat6 lok6 syut3 wo3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sami isn't as crazy as everybody thinks he is.

jyutping: sam1 mei5 mou5 di1 jan2 nam2 dou3 keoi5 gam3 din1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I left my card at home.

jyutping: ngo5 lau6 zo2 zoeng1 kaa1 hai2 uk1 kei2。

jyutping: ngo5 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 hou2 gwo3 ngo5 ge3 pou2 tung1 waa2。

english.text: I know you're going to love this book.

jyutping: nei5 jat1 ding6 wui5 zung1 ji3 ne1 bun2 syu1 ge3。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Was the umbrella you found Tom's?

jyutping: nei5 kwan2 dou3 go2 baa2 ze1 hai6 mai6 tong1 mou5 gaa4？

english.text: Pets are not allowed in our hotel.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zau2 dim3 m4 ho2 ji5 zeon2 daai2 cung2 mat6 jap6 zyu6 gaa3。

english.text: Explain what the following sentences mean in the metaphor of trawling: (a) “trawl nets into the sea” (b) “collect all kinds of fish” and (c) “take the good into vessels”; (D) “Throw away the ones that don’t fit”.

jyutping: cing2 gaai2 sik1 hai2 to1 mong5 ge3 bei2 jyu6 jap6 min6，haa6 min6 ge3 geoi3 zi2 jau5 me1 ham4 ji3：（gaap3）「to1 mong5 saat3 lok6 hoi2 jap6 min6」；（jyut3）「sau1 zaap6 gok3 leoi6 ge3 jyu4」；（bing2）「zoeng1 hou2 ge3 sau1 jap6 hei3 ming5」；(ding1)「m4 ngaam1 jung6 ge3 zau6 dam1 zo2 keoi5」。
text: 請解釋喺拖網嘅比喻入面，下面嘅句子有咩含意：（甲）「拖網撒落海入面」；（乙）「收集各類嘅魚」；（丙）「將好嘅收入器皿」；(丁)「唔啱用嘅就揼咗佢」。

english.text: Data from Hubble has allowed astronomers to make cosmic breakthroughs: pin down the age of the universe by measuring the brightness of stars in distant galaxies, watch comets plunge into Jupiter’s clouds, providing new insights into the physics of the stormy planet, and take the very first images of planet-forming disks around newborn stars, something astronomers knew had to be there but never dreamed they’d see with their own eyes.

text: 哈佛嘅數據令到天文學家可以做到宇宙突破：透過測量遠方銀河系嘅恆星嘅亮度嚟確定宇宙嘅年齡，睇住彗星潛入木星嘅雲層，為呢個風暴行星嘅物理學提供新嘅見解，同埋攞到宇宙嘅第一個圖像，係新生恆星周圍嘅行星形成盤，天文學家知道一定要喺嗰度，但係從來都冇發過夢，佢哋會用自己嘅眼睛睇得到。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: In the biggest heist ever on U.S. soil, armed mobsters stole $5 million in cash and nearly $1 million in jewels from a Lufthansa Airlines vault at New York's John F. Kennedy airport on December 11, 1978.

author: Matthewyau1367
